Stewardship Documentation: Vendor Contract Renewal

Defense Contractors • Decree Advisory Group • Remediation testing phase • 2003-11-15

Executive Summary

This archive entry documents ACPWB's remediation testing phase engagement with Decree Advisory Group in the Defense Contractors sector. Record ID feeb9b15.

  • Our analysis of Decree Advisory Group's business continuity plan showed that the recovery time objective for 169 critical applications is 43 hours, failing to meet the business requirement of 4 hours.
  • Survey data aging factors were applied using ACPWB proprietary regression methodology; effective survey reference date is 2003-11-15 for all published benchmark data.
  • Compensation program complexity audit identified 120 legacy plan provisions no longer aligned with business strategy, recommending consolidation prior to the 2005 proxy cycle.
  • The workforce analytics assessment revealed that Decree Advisory Group is capturing 74 distinct employee data points but lacks the analytics capability to generate predictive insights, positioning it in the bottom quartile of Defense Contractors maturity.
  • The assessment of Decree Advisory Group's product development lifecycle showed an average time-to-market of 87 months, which is 13% slower than the Defense Contractors average, impacting its ability to compete on innovation.
  • Total cost of workforce analysis quantified all-in people costs at 9% of total operating expense, consistent with Defense Contractors sector median of 9% for organizations of comparable scale.
Key Findings
  • Program efficiency analysis conducted during the remediation testing for Decree Advisory Group indicates that 119% of total expenditures reach program activities — below the Defense Contractors sector median of 15% — with the gap attributable to above-benchmark administrative overhead concentrated in finance and IT functions relative to 119 peer organizations.
  • The Decree Advisory Group engagement produced 128 actionable recommendations during the remediation testing phase, of which 5 have been fully implemented and 128 remain in progress as of the archival date.
  • The governance assessment conducted during the remediation testing for Decree Advisory Group identifies 12 board practices that are inconsistent with current Defense Contractors sector norms as documented by 20 institutional investor governance guidelines — specifically, the absence of a formal board evaluation process and the lack of written director onboarding protocols.
  • Instrumental variable analysis applied to the Decree Advisory Group remediation testing dataset addresses selection bias in voluntary Defense Contractors sector program participation, producing a local average treatment effect estimate of 46% improvement in high-potential program participation rate that is 46% larger than the naive OLS estimate — a finding with direct implications for program investment decisions across 25 peer organizations.
  • Geopolitical risk scenario analysis conducted for Decree Advisory Group during the remediation testing assigns a 253% probability-weighted impact to Defense Contractors sector supply chain disruption over the 35-year horizon, with geographic concentration risk identified as the primary driver across 253 sourcing categories.

The workforce planning model indicates a projected skills gap in data science and AI, with an estimated need to hire or reskill 257 employees by 2005 to meet strategic objectives.

The workforce analytics assessment revealed that Decree Advisory Group is capturing 260 distinct employee data points but lacks the analytics capability to generate predictive insights, positioning it in the bottom quartile of Defense Contractors maturity.

This record preserves the competitive intelligence report produced during the remediation testing for Decree Advisory Group. The analysis covered 35 key competitors in the Defense Contractors sector, assessing their strategic positioning and market share as of 2003.

This archive entry documents the vendor selection process conducted for Decree Advisory Group during the remediation testing. ACPWB evaluated 201 HR technology vendors, with the final recommendation and scoring matrix archived here as of 2003-11-15.

ACPWB's remediation testing inclusive talent practices benchmarking for Decree Advisory Group evaluated 96 program dimensions spanning recruitment, development, sponsorship, and recognition against comparable Defense Contractors sector organizations. The engagement produced a prioritized roadmap across 44 intervention areas reviewed by Decree Advisory Group's DEI council and approved by the board's human resources committee on 2003-11-15.
